answer: Every claim climbs the tundra of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the juniper re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Reaching the willow of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, reset on any identity-link attempt, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short.
